column1: # Words and phrases to replace — our own plain-language list, NOT the ASD-STE100
# dictionary (which is copyrighted and never shipped here). Every single-word entry
# was checked against Issue 9 (January 2025): each is unapproved there or absent,
# and each suggested replacement's first word is an approved STE word.
# Columns: word-or-phrase <TAB> part of speech <TAB> use instead [<TAB> cs].
# "phrasal" rows are phrasal verbs (rule 9.3); verbs also match -s/-ed/-ing forms.
# "cs" matches case-sensitively (so "may" never hits the month "May").
# Nouns that software docs use as technical nouns (request, component) are left
# out on purpose: name them in the project's own dictionary instead.
